kits.lead: Complete systems built from products we stock: inverter, batteries, panels, mounting and cabling, checked for compatibility. Order a kit as one item, or ask us to adapt it to your site.
kits.custom: Need a different size, another brand or a roof type not listed here? Send us the site details and we'll put together a kit.

home6.name: Home hybrid 6 kW
home6.useCase: A private house on a single-phase connection. Solar power by day, battery in the evening and during outages. Pitched metal or trapezoidal roof.

business12.name: Three-phase hybrid 12 kW
business12.useCase: A large house or small business on a three-phase connection, with a flat roof. Cuts daytime grid use and keeps critical loads running.

backup4.name: Backup power 4 kW
backup4.useCase: No panels: the battery charges from the grid and takes over during outages. For homes, shops and offices that need power through blackouts.

about.heading: About us
about.lead: Sunora Components is a wholesale distributor of solar equipment, based in Tallinn, Estonia.
about.story1: We are not a retail shop. We work with installers, dealers and EPC contractors who buy in volume, and we supply them with inverters, batteries and solar panels.
about.story2: We distribute five manufacturers: Felicity Solar, MUST, DAH Solar, LONGi and Deye. That covers a full system, from panels on the roof to the inverter and battery storage.
about.story3: Our market is Eastern Europe. We deliver large orders to Kyiv, Odesa, Bucharest, Chișinău and Warsaw, and quote delivery to other cities on request.
